messages:
Maya Patel: Drafting installer acceptance criteria — need quick sync on what we must guarantee for GA (VPC/on-prem). Posting a compact checklist, please flag anything missing.
Ashley Chen: thanks Maya — quick q: do we need KMS integration for GA or can that be beta gated? Customers keep asking about key ownership.
Samir Gupta: I'd push for KMS GA for enterprise tier. At minimum: documented KMS flow + test harness. We can default to Redwood-managed keys for self-serve but require customer opt-in for private deployments.
Oliver Park: Agree with Samir. Also: network requirements need to be explicit — ingress/egress ports, proxy support, and an explicit offline install path for air-gapped customers.
Maya Patel: Proposed acceptance checklist (compact):
- Installer runs fully in air-gapped mode with local package bundle
- Customer-managed KMS supported (AKS/GCP/Azure + HSM via KMIP) or documented fallback
- Clear network port matrix + proxy env vars
- Deterministic upgrade path (no schema drift) + rollback script
- Handshake API for peering + IP preservation guidance
- Automated e2e smoke test that validates model load + routing policy
- Field pilot runbook and feedback loop integrated to tracking board
Additions?
Ashley Chen: Suggest adding: metrics export (Prometheus) endpoints enabled by default and document retention guidance for logs/alerts.
Samir Gupta: Also need an operator UX note: how to pin model versions, how to set canary rollout percentages, and a playbook for emergency fallback to hosted models.
Maya Patel: Good — I'll add operator UX. For KMS: Samir, who owns the test harness? Also we need acceptance test that validates key rotation without downtime.
Samir Gupta: Infra team (Samir) will own harness. Rotation test: we simulate rotation with a short-lived key and assert no inference failures for 10m. I'll add steps.
Oliver Park: On upgrade/rollback: must support min-downtime upgrade target (<=5% request loss during upgrade window) and a documented network quiesce procedure.
Ashley Chen: For launch gates, propose: 1) internal e2e pass, 2) 2 pilot customers onboarded with success criteria, 3) doc set + runbooks reviewed, 4) security signoff (KMS & networking).
Maya Patel: Sounds good. Who wants to own pilot recruitment and success criteria definition? We need two different network topologies: cloud-VPC peering and air-gapped on-prem.
Oliver Park: I'll take pilot recruitment for cloud-VPC peering. Ashley — can you lead on air-gapped pilot outreach with CS?
Ashley Chen: Yep, will coordinate with CS and provide list by EOD Fri. Need a templated install checklist for pilots.
pkg-bot: Automated checklist created: https://ci.redwood.internal/installer/checklists/2381234 — includes ports, env vars, and smoke test commands.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items summarized:
- Maya: update acceptance checklist with metrics + operator UX (due Tue)
- Samir: test harness + key rotation test plan (due Mon)
- Oliver: pilot recruitment (cloud-VPC) + upgrade success metrics (due Wed)
- Ashley: pilot recruitment (air-gapped) + templated install checklist (due Fri)
- pkg-bot: keep checklist link updated during changes
We'll reconvene next Tue to sign the GA gates if pilots progress. If anyone wants to push scope narrower for earlier ship, call it out now.
Samir Gupta: If we need narrower scope, we can ship GA without air-gapped install but with a clear 'air-gapped beta' label and timeline. That would speed timelines by ~3 weeks.
Ashley Chen: Noted. But several enterprise deals require air-gap. Sales says some will wait. Need a risk decision from PMs.
Maya Patel: I'll surface tradeoff to PM leadership today with estimated delta. Thanks all — leaving this thread open for minor edits. :thumbsup:
